input.quote: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
input.rationale: Section 10.3(A) (p0183) is a de facto all-requirements/exclusive-dealing commitment: Customer must obtain from M&I every Service included in the Monthly Base Fee "during the Term", and "Term" is defined (p0049) as running to the eighth anniversary of the Commencement Date. There is no limitation to a defined product category, no 12-month cap, and no automatic release on M&I's failure to meet the Performance Standards (Article 9) or delivery/processing deadlines, so all four fallback elements fail and the clause sits in walk-away territory (exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit). No other provision cures this: Section 21.10 (p0280) and 21.11 (p0281) merely define scope and pricing assumptions, and the Section 1.1(C) recital (p0023) is not an operative sourcing covenant; the only other "exclusive" references run in Customer's favour or are unrelated. We therefore target the preferred position and make the single surgical replacement of the offending sentence, leaving the pricing acknowledgment intact.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.

proposal.summary: Remove the all-requirements sourcing obligation in Section 10.3(A) and confirm M&I is a non-exclusive provider.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3(A) requires us to source all Monthly Base Fee Services from M&I for the entire eight-year Term with no performance-based exit, which is exclusive dealing we cannot accept. We have replaced that sentence so M&I is a non-exclusive provider and we remain free to obtain services elsewhere; if M&I needs some commitment we can discuss a defined category capped at 12 months that ends automatically on any failure to meet the Performance Standards or delivery dates.

ops.oldText: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
ops.newText: M&I shall be a non-exclusive provider of the Services, and Customer shall have no obligation to obtain any Services exclusively from M&I.
